name: Self-Directed Queries Complexity / Littlestone Dimension
details: For a nonempty finite binary class on a domain of size $n\ge1$, $\mathrm M_{\mathrm{sd}}(\mathcal H)\ge \mathrm L(\mathcal H)/\log_2(n+1)$. The stronger counting bound uses the whole-domain mistake cost $k$: $|\mathcal H|\le\sum_{j=0}^k\binom nj\le(n+1)^k$. The unshifted denominator is false even for thresholds on three points.
